svg.title: Annapurna — mountain relief
svg.desc: North and northeast face panorama. Summit ridge, steep northern headwall, hanging snowfields and subsidiary ice buttresses. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Theprotrekker. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Annapurna_1_from_NE-E.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
